clue.text: Canny wee sister craftily hides joint

indicators.note: the rearranged letters hide a further letter inside them
done craftily, the letters of the two words are worked into a new order

parts.note: a T is a T-shaped joint, as in plumbing

explanation.surface: A shrewd little sister cleverly conceals a cannabis joint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'craftily' rearranges WEE SISTER; 'hides' tucks T, the T-joint of plumbing, into it. 'joint' looks like the cannabis cigarette of the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone canny is shrewd and worldly, knowing how to look after themselves in city life.

clue.text: Take a risk and talk about religion in Northern Ireland

indicators.note: the word for talk is placed round the remaining letters

parts.note: to talk is to chat

indicators.note: the religion letters sit inside the Northern Ireland letters

parts.note: CE, the Church of England, stands for religion

explanation.surface: Raising religion in Northern Ireland conversation is a gamble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'religion' is the Church of England in its usual abbreviation, a convention worth learning.
explanation.definitionFit: To chance it is an informal idiom for trying something risky and hoping it works out.

clue.text: Line in sacred text upset prostitute

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset turns the letters bottom to top
the line letter goes inside the sacred text

parts.note: the Torah is the Jewish sacred law

explanation.surface: A verse in scripture that offends by mentioning a prostitute.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts L into TORAH to give TORLAH; 'upset' turns that upside down in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A harlot is an old-fashioned word for a woman who sells sex.

clue.text: Company providing lifts back to outskirts of Inverness

indicators.note: back says the little word is read in the opposite direction
the outskirts of a town are its edges, so the first and last letters are taken

explanation.surface: A firm giving people rides back to the edge of a Scottish town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns TO into OT; 'outskirts of' takes I and S from Inverness. 'lifts' suggests car rides, but means elevators.
explanation.definitionFit: Otis is the best-known maker of elevators, which British English calls lifts.

clue.text: Initial pairing of New Moon and Aries around the 3rd of August

indicators.note: the first part goes around the single letter
new suggests the word is made over, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: Aries is the Ram of the zodiac

indicators.note: picks out the third letter of the next word

explanation.surface: An astrological note about a new moon in Aries in early August.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' works as the anagram signal on 'Moon' only; Aries, the Ram of the zodiac, joins after it, and 'around' takes the G.
explanation.definitionFit: A monogram is a design interweaving a person's initials, so it is a pairing of letters.

clue.text: Get even-shaven genital parts

indicators.note: parts says only some letters of the words are taken, running across them

explanation.surface: A crude instruction about grooming private parts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'parts' takes letters from shAVEN GEnital. The hyphen joins 'even' to 'shaven' in the surface, but 'Get even' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To get even is to take revenge for a wrong, which is what avenging means.

clue.text: Record Irishman coming up on Ecstasy

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming up means the name reads from the bottom

parts.note: Pat is the stock Irish name in crosswords
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: An Irishman's drug trip gets recorded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming up' works because this is a down entry, read from the bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: To tape something is to record it, as on audio or video cassette.

clue.text: Make carvings and suchlike with tip of hacksaw

parts.note: et cetera, abbreviated ETC, means and suchlike

indicators.note: the tip is the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: Carving with a hacksaw blade and similar tools.
explanation.definitionFit: To etch is to cut lines into a surface, a form of engraving.

clue.text: Van or Ute sprayed gold has style

indicators.note: spraying scatters, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: A van or utility truck resprayed gold looks stylish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sprayed' rearranges VANORUTE into ARTNOUVE. A Ute is an Australian pick-up truck.
explanation.definitionFit: Art nouveau is a decorative style of the 1890s and 1900s, with flowing plant-like lines.

clue.text: Royal figure

parts.note: not a royal person but a numeral attached to a monarch's name, like the II after Elizabeth

explanation.surface: A member of the royal family.
explanation.walkthrough: 'figure' suggests a person; here it is a number.
explanation.definitionFit: A regnal number distinguishes monarchs of the same name, so it is a number belonging to a reign.

clue.text: Pampered boy crosses river with government agent

indicators.note: the boy goes across, so round, the river

parts.note: a son is a boy
the Po is the main river of northern Italy
a fed is an American federal agent

explanation.surface: A spoilt boy crosses a river with an FBI man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crosses' means the boy straddles the river, holding it inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A pampered person has had everything done for them, as if fed with a spoon.

clue.text: Swore at journalist covering trial

parts.note: a test is a trial
ED, an editor, is the usual crossword journalist

explanation.surface: Cursing a reporter who is covering a court case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swore at' looks like the definition, but only 'Swore' defines; AT is the first piece.
explanation.definitionFit: To attest is to declare something true, as a witness does under oath.

clue.text: Drained delta on estate

parts.note: D is delta in the phonetic alphabet
an estate is a social class or rank, as in the three estates of the realm

explanation.surface: A river delta on a country estate is drained.
explanation.definitionFit: A drained glass has been emptied, which is what you have done if you drank it.

clue.text: Almost bursting on Parisian street? In a sorry state!

indicators.note: in an across clue, one piece on another follows it

parts.note: rue is French for street

indicators.note: almost means the last letter of the word is lost

parts.note: full to bursting means full

explanation.surface: A packed Paris street leaves someone feeling low.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' sets the French street before the trimmed word, RUE-FUL.
explanation.definitionFit: Rueful means regretful, feeling sorry for something done.

clue.text: Bruce worked with Andy to contain a problem in city

indicators.note: the rearranged letters hold the next piece
worked letters are kneaded into a new shape

explanation.surface: Two men team up to tackle a problem in the city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worked' makes URBNDECY from the two names; 'to contain' then takes in the clue's own 'a'.
explanation.definitionFit: Urban decay is the decline of run-down parts of a city, a chronic civic problem.

clue.text: Suggest knight is involved in planned murder

indicators.note: the knight piece is taken up inside the murder word

parts.note: a hit is a contract killing
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A knight is implicated in a murder plot.
explanation.definitionFit: To hint is to suggest something indirectly.

clue.text: Daily Mail's initial allure

parts.note: a daily is a British term for a cleaner who comes in each day, also called a char

indicators.note: the initial is the first letter

explanation.surface: The appeal of the Daily Mail newspaper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Daily Mail' looks like the newspaper, but 'Daily' is a cleaning lady, or char, in British slang.
explanation.definitionFit: Charm and allure both mean the power to attract.

clue.text: Cab, say, dropping Oscar in middle of ring road

indicators.note: the letter is dropped into the next pieces
the letter lands between the two words

parts.note: to ring is to call by phone
a way is a road
O is Oscar in the phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A taxi drops a passenger in the middle of a ring road.
explanation.walkthrough: Cab Calloway was an American jazz bandleader. 'Cab' looks like a taxi.
explanation.definitionFit: Cab is the first name of Calloway, the singer of Minnie the Moocher, so he is an example.

clue.text: English pound a Napoleonic prison

parts.note: lb is the abbreviation for a pound weight

explanation.surface: An English pound as a jail for Napoleon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pound' could be an animal enclosure, but here it is the weight.
explanation.definitionFit: Napoleon was exiled to the island of Elba in 1814.

clue.text: Group seen performing with Mel B on tour

indicators.note: letters that perform move about into a new arrangement
touring letters travel round into a new order

explanation.surface: A band seen playing live with Mel B, the Spice Girl.
explanation.definitionFit: An ensemble is a group of musicians or performers.

clue.text: Goddess welcomes bishop with fifty varieties of tea

definitions.note: the definition describes the adjective's use in herbal teas

indicators.note: the goddess takes the bishop in

parts.note: Hera is the Greek queen of the gods
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Hera serves a bishop many kinds of tea.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition stands for the adjective as used in herbal varieties.
explanation.definitionFit: Herbal teas are infusions of plants rather than tea leaves.

clue.text: Democrat in New York bolstering supporter's spirit

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece bolstering another sits beneath it

parts.note: a bra is a supporting garment

indicators.note: the Democrat letter goes inside New York's letters

parts.note: D stands for Democrat in US politics

explanation.surface: A New York Democrat props up a supporter's morale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bolstering' puts NDY below BRA in this down entry; 'spirit' looks like morale.
explanation.definitionFit: Brandy is a spirit distilled from wine.

clue.text: Twisted knee, having stood in oil

indicators.note: the rearranged letters take the next piece
the stood word goes inside
twisted letters are bent into a new order

parts.note: rose, as in stood up, means stood

explanation.surface: Someone with a twisted knee, standing in oil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Twisted' gives KENE; 'having ... in' holds the past tense of rise, read as stood up.
explanation.definitionFit: Kerosene is paraffin oil, used as fuel for lamps and jets.

clue.text: Forest defender denying second to Scottish team

indicators.note: denying the letter means leaving it out

parts.note: Rangers is a Glasgow football club

explanation.surface: A Nottingham Forest defender turns away a Scottish team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Forest defender' suggests Nottingham Forest football club, but it is someone guarding a forest.
explanation.definitionFit: A forest ranger protects woodland and its wildlife.

clue.text: Leave hearing aid in box

indicators.note: the hearing word goes inside the box word

parts.note: to box is to hit, to clout
the ear is the organ that aids hearing

explanation.surface: Leaving a hearing aid in a box.
explanation.walkthrough: 'box' seems a container, but is a verb: clout.
explanation.definitionFit: To clear out is an informal phrase meaning to leave quickly.

clue.text: Youth accepts universal homage

indicators.note: the youth takes the letter in

parts.note: a lad is a youth
U is the film certificate for universal viewing

explanation.surface: A young man accepts universal admiration.
explanation.definitionFit: Laud as a noun is praise, the tribute that homage pays.

clue.text: Like takeaway food in African country

definitions.meaning: food ... is bought to eat elsewhere
a West African nation between Ghana and Benin

explanation.surface: Takeaway meals in an African country.
explanation.definitionFit: Togo is a small country on the Gulf of Guinea, and to go describes takeaway orders.

clue.text: See 10
Square reported argument about a bike

indicators.note: reported speech is heard, so the phrase is spoken

parts.note: a wrangle, or argument, over a quad, a four-wheeled bike

explanation.surface: A dispute about a bicycle in a town square.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reported' says QUAD WRANGLE, said out loud, gives the word.
explanation.definitionFit: A quadrangle is a square courtyard, as in a college.

clue.text: Heavy metal front man

definitions.meaning: a dense grey metal, symbol Pb
the singer at the head of a band, or someone in front

explanation.surface: The singer of a heavy metal band.
explanation.definitionFit: Lead is a heavy metal, and the lead is the person in front, such as a band's singer.
